LICIK!!!

This isn’t about fairness or recognising merit — it’s about setting things up. The politician honours Village A first because everyone agrees it deserves it. No pushback, no controversy. That first move makes everything look reasonable and clean, and it lowers people’s guard.

Once that’s done, Village B gets slipped in under the same label. Suddenly questioning it sounds petty or “inconsistent,” even though Village B never earned it. It’s an old political trick: use a good decision to justify a bad one. A genuine act becomes cover, not principle — and if you’re not paying attention, it works.

Liability Kerajaan? Part 2 (Letupan Paip Gas Petronas Putra Heights)

Setiap hari, sedikit demi sedikit kerajaan Selangor terpaksa mengaku kebenaran diberikan untuk buat kerja sana sini di Putra Heights walaupun pada mulanya persoalan mana jentera tu ditanya pihak berkuasa. 

Sekarang, pihak polis pun keluar kata, "The excavation works to replace the sewer pipes were carried out with the necessary approval." (1)

Jadi ada yang tanya, bukankah PBT dan kerajaan negeri tidak perlu bertanggungjawab kerana ada 'immunity' di bawah perundangan kita?

Hah. Jawapannya ialah 'Ya'. Kebenaran yang diberikan kerajaan kebiasaannya ada klausa di mana pihak yang buat kerja perlu bertanggungjawab untuk segala masalah yang berlaku. Ia ada termaktub dalam Akta Kerajaan Tempatan, Uniform Building By-Laws dan juga pada borang-borang permohonan dan surat kebenaran yang kerajaan bagi.

Ada contoh di mana "Permohonan Permit Bagi Menjalankan Kerja-Kerja Pembaikan Paip Pembentungan Secara Kaedah Korekan Terbuka DILULUSKAN oleh KUSEL dan MBSJ dari 8 Oktober 2024 hingga 8 Januari 2025" yang didedahkan beberapa hari lalu di mana perenggan 5 menyatakan, ""Pihak Penyedia Utiliti Perlu Bertanggungjawab Sekiranya Terdapat Kerosakan Jalan Atau Harta Benda Awam Yang Disebabkan Oleh Aktiviti Pengorekan Dan Pemasangan Utiliti Bawah Tanah Tersebut." (2) (also see edit)

Ramai yang baca perenggan ini ingatkan Petronas yang kena bertanggungjawab. Itu salah. Keyword dalam perenggan kelima ialah 'pihak penyedia utiliti' itu bermaksud pihak yang buat kerja, ataupun dalam perkataan yang kita semua biasa gunakan, 'kontraktor'.

Disebabkan ada klausa sebegini, kontraktor biasanya ada liabiilty insurance mereka tersendiri. Misalnya, kalau kontraktor buat kerja jalan raya dan dinding rumah kamu pecah akibat kecuaian kerja tersebut, kontraktor perlu membaiki dinding rumah kamu dan kos itu akan dibayar pihak insurance (dan premium kontraktor tu akan naik lah selepas tu).

Now, let's talk about the dilemma. 

Walaupun ada pelbagai klausa serta undang-undang yang mewajibkan kontraktor bertanggungjawab dan wujudnya liabiilty insurance, there's no freaking way a contractor or their insurance provider is paying for the damages in the Putra Heights gas explosion disaster.

Laporan media kata 25 rumah habis terbakar. 219 rumah lain mengalami kerosakan, dan dari jumlah tu, 87 rumah mengalami kerosakan 20% keatas (major damage). "A total of 399 vehicles were also affected, with 225 burnt and 174 damaged." (3)

Adakah anda ingat itu saja yang perlu dibayar? Haha.

Paip petronas tu juga perlu dibaiki. Dan selagi paip itu tak dibaiki, kita ada kos kehilangan bekalan gas kepada 200 kilang dan bisnes. (4)

Kamu hitungkan kos kerosakan rumah, kereta, pembaikan semula paip gas semua tu, kontraktor tu jadi bankrap pun dia tak akan mampu nak bayar semua ni. Liability insurance dia pun ada had juga. 

Jadi suka, tak suka, kerajaan dan Petronas perlu bertanggungjawab. 

Di situ juga masalahnya. Kerajaan perlu bayar kan? Itu semua duit kita. Our tax money.

Tahun lepas, cukai pintu kita dah naik. Banyak cukai lain pun dah naik. Sebab kerajaan Selangor juga yang perlu masuk campur dan bayar benda ni, adakah ia berkemungkinan cukai kita tak naik lagi?

Revenue kerajaan Selangor sekitar RM2.4 bil pada tahun 2024. (5)

Even if you give a conservative estimate that the damages are around RM500 million, that's still a quarter of Selangor government's income. 

Haih.

Peace.

Sebab saya kata ia adalah kontraktor ialah kerana kertas kerja yang dirujuk adalah untuk kerja paip pembentungan dan kebiasaannya, pemaju yang buat sambungan itu dengan kontraktornya selepas mendapat kelulusan.

Kalau kamu nak kata ia tidak merujuk kepada kontraktor pun, ia akan merujuk kepada IWK dan bukannya Petronas juga.

"Why did you lie to me?" Ji Ja asked angrily to Ja Ji.
Ja Ji replied, "Why is it okay for you to lie, but not for me? You lied before, even taught us how to lie. I saw how things turned out fine for you—even though you were proven to have lied, you still made it big and were even celebrated."

Ji Ja was still unsatisfied and now even more furious.
"Hey! You didn’t answer my question. Why are you dragging me into this? Yes, I lied—but people believed me. Do you have that? Even if I lied, some people succeeded in life because of my lies. You? You’re different. You didn’t lie to others, you lied to me."

The above dialogue is purely fictional and has no connection to anyone you might be imagining right now. The person you’re picturing is merely a mental image you created from your imagination.

However, we cannot deny that there are people who take pride in lying. In the past, people would lie discreetly. Today, people lie openly.

Why? Because if you lie secretly, not many will know your "greatness"—which you want to use to deceive others.

I have many friends who are currently pursuing or have completed their PhDs. None of them ever said it was easy to earn that degree. Most people understand how tough it is to get a PhD, yet the public can still be fooled by someone claiming to have multiple PhDs!

Getting one PhD is already tough—and now here’s someone with several?

I’m referring to the Information Minister of Zimbabwe, Jenfran Muswere, who claimed he had two PhDs—one in ICT, Performance, Corporate Governance, and Public Management, and the other in Strategic Mining PPP Investments.

Not only that, he also claimed to have an MBA in International Trade.

Thanks to his fake academic credentials, he won the election and was appointed as Information Minister.

But the most impressive part isn’t the lie—it’s how boldly he showed his face in public, and how many people were eager to learn from him and take pictures with a fraud.

No one is born with the skill to lie. It begins when they observe adults and those around them lying—and benefiting from it. That’s where they get the idea that lying is good… for themselves.

Not for others, but for themselves.
Liars prioritise self-interest—not the interests of others—but they will market their self-interest as being for the public good.

People wouldn't fall for lies if the liar were to admit up front that he is lying purely for his own gain.
Some might realise it after the fact—but even then, they will justify it:
"Yes, he lied, but he helped the people, he's efficient at work, don't bring up the past."

I repeat:
Liars love to lie because the ones being lied to are willing to be deceived—and even defend the lie, even glorify the liar.
And when liars are celebrated by those they deceive, it shows that the deceived are also looking for opportunities to lie.
And so the cycle continues.
That is the cycle of the life of lies.

“Be truthful, for truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise. A man will keep speaking the truth and striving to speak the truth until he will be recorded with Allah as a truthful person. And beware of lying, for lying leads to wickedness, and wickedness leads to Hell. A man will keep telling lies and striving to tell lies until he is recorded with Allah as a liar.”
(Hadith narrated by Muslim)

Undoubtedly, the uncertain global economic situation has caused a very challenging situation for the people.

That is why various initiatives are being implemented by the Government led by YAB Prime Minister Dato' Seri Ismail Sabri Yaakob, from the issue of poverty to drastically reducing unemployment.

There is still much to be done to correct the situation of the people who have been affected by the great blow since the Covid pandemic.

But this is not a reason for certain individuals to throw labels without a mirror. Especially when the individual is:
- Chairman of the National Rehabilitation Council
- Former Prime Minister who made many awkward decisions
- The president of the party that has a representative in the Cabinet is included in the economic portfolio

1) Tan Sri Muhyiddin said:
Many companies were forced to scale back operations or close.
Answer:
What is the reason? Probably when? Try to see how many companies closed when he was PM? Over 100,000 businesses closed operations during Covid.
Yes partly due to the peak of Covid. But partly also because the Prime Minister at the time himself was not clear on the way out of the shackles of Covid. Snap A, snap B. Snap open snap close.
Fortunately DSIS became PM, reopened the economy. Attract investment until the highest figure in history was recorded at RM72.9 billion for a period of 9 months.
Through Budget 2022, the PM has also introduced the Semarak Niaga program amounting to RM40 billion to help entrepreneurs and businesses rebuild their sources of livelihood.
This is also complemented by the Jamin Kerja initiative with an allocation of RM4.8 billion to create job opportunities for all affected Malaysian Families.
As a result of this, unemployment fell for 12 consecutive months after DSIS became PM to 3.8% and the total employment status increased by 600,000 from August 2021 to July 2022. In fact, sales of wholesale and retail goods also increased at the highest rate throughout this year. Bankruptcy rates also decreased this year.
If Tan Sri Muhyiddin? Lockdown until when? What kind of work or business do you want? What kind of income do you want?

2) TSMY said:
The ringgit is weak.
Answer:
- No one denies that the Malaysian ringgit is depreciating against the US dollar. But stronger than the British Pound, Japanese Yen, South Korean Won, and several other currencies.
- TSMY said the Government is not serious about restoring the Ringgit against the Dollar. What is TSMY's great idea? Want to tie currency? Want to do "capital controls"? Want to use our international reserves? If so, say so. And ready to defend the idea. If as far as the ringgit goes down, but there is no awareness of the cause, the idea is far away, what's the point?
Interest rates in the United States are rising rapidly. If Malaysia takes more aggressive action, the ringgit is likely to strengthen a little but the people will face a higher debt payment rate. TSMY wants to ask the OPR to increase by what percentage?

3) TSMY said:
There are people who are slow to pay their debts or are tied up.
Answer:
Naturally, there are people who are having a hard time. There are indeed difficult SMEs. But look at the efforts made in Budget 2022, among them as mentioned in point (1). Interest-free loans, loans with a 6-month moratorium are all among the efforts in Semarak Niaga.
DSIS has also called on financial institutions not to take action against any SME that fails to repay loans. In fact, Bank Rakyat and SME Bank are among the banking institutions that have not taken any action.
The era of Tan Sri Muhyiddin as if no one had a stomachache? Have we forgotten what happened?
Many cannot afford basic necessities so people ask for help by raising the white flag. What is TSMY's comment?

4) TSMY said:
Malaysia imports most of its food needs.
Answer:
From long ago. But what did TSMY do when he was PM to improve the food safety position?
Under DSIS, bold actions with the elimination of AP, freezing of chicken exports abroad, loan facilities for farmers and food producers, subsidies for chicken operators and others.
This food safety issue is all a continuation of the policies during the era of Pak Lah and Dato' Sri Najib. From the 'Agriculture for All' Policy to the National Agro-Food Policy.
What is TSMY's policy? Or his legacy?

5) TSMY said:
It is good that elections are held so that the new Government can be chosen by the people.
Answer:
After that, why are you demanding the positions of TPM and Ministers? BN has been talking about getting a mandate from this election since February 2020. Different from TSMY. Let alone the election, the Parliament session was avoided through emergency. So it's a bit awkward to suddenly talk about the people's mandate. Anyway, when the general election comes we will see who actually failed.

As a result, in this economy, nothing is perfect. There are still many problems to overcome. But at least the foundation stone has been laid and progress achieved from the bottom position when TSMY resigned. From all that progress, we will continue our efforts.

Tidak dinafikan, keadaan ekonomi global yang tidak menentu telah menyebabkan situasi yang amat mencabar untuk rakyat. 

Sebab itu pelbagai inisiatif dilaksanakan oleh Kerajaan pimpinan YAB Perdana Menteri Dato' Seri Ismail Sabri Yaakob, dari soal kemiskinan sehinggalah menurunkan pengangguran dengan drastik.

Masih banyak yang perlu dilakukan untuk perbetul keadaan rakyat yang terkesan dari tamparan hebat sejak pandemik Covid.

Tapi ini bukan alasan untuk individu tertentu melemparkan label tanpa cermin diri. Terutamanya apabila individu itu ialah:
- Pengerusi Majlis Pemulihan Negara
- Bekas Perdana Menteri yang banyak buat keputusan janggal
- Presiden parti yang ada wakil dalam Kabinet termasuk dalam portfolio ekonomi

1) Tan Sri Muhyiddin kata:

Banyak syarikat terpaksa kecilkan operasi atau tutup. 

Jawapan:

Agaknya sebab apa? Agaknya zaman bila? Cuba tengok berapa syarikat yang tutup semasa dia jadi PM? Lebih 100,000 perniagaan tutup operasi semasa Covid.

Ya sebahagiannya disebabkan Covid memuncak. Tapi sebahagiannya juga sebab Perdana Menteri waktu itu sendiri tidak ada ketegasan apa jalan keluar dari belenggu Covid. Kejap A, kejap B. Kejap buka kejap tutup.

Mujur DSIS jadi PM, buka semula ekonomi. Tarik pelaburan sehingga angka tertinggi dalam sejarah dicatat sebanyak RM72.9 bilion bagi tempoh 9 bulan.

Melalui Bajet 2022, PM juga telah memperkenalkan program Semarak Niaga berjumlah RM40 bilion untuk membantu usahawan dan perniagaan bina semula punca rezeki mereka.

Ini juga dilengkapi oleh inisiatif Jamin Kerja dengan peruntukan berjumlah RM4.8 bilion untuk mewujudkan peluang pekerjaan bagi seluruh Keluarga Malaysia yang terjejas.

Hasil daripada ini, pengangguran turun 12 bulan berturut-turut setelah DSIS jadi PM kepada 3.8% dan jumlah status bekerja naik 600,000 dari Ogos 2021 hingga Julai 2022. Malah, jualan barangan borong dan runcit juga meningkat dengan kadar tertinggi sepanjang tahun ini. Kadar muflis juga menurun tahun ini.

Kalau Tan Sri Muhyiddin? Lockdown sampai bila? Nak kerja atau berniaga macam mana? Nak dapat pendapatan macam mana?

2) TSMY kata:

Ringgit lemah.

Jawapan:

- Tidak ada sesiapa yang menafikan bahawa ringgit Malaysia menyusut berbanding US dolar. Tetapi lebih kukuh berbanding British Pound, Yen Jepun, South Korean Won, dan beberapa matawang lain.

- TSMY berkata Kerajaan tak bersungguh-sungguh memulihkan Ringgit berbanding Dolar. Apa idea hebat TSMY? Hendak tambat matawang? Hendak buat "capital controls"? Hendak pakai rizab antarabangsa kita? Kalau ya, cakap la. Dan bersedia pertahankan idea itu. Kalau setakat kata Ringgit susut tapi tak ada kesedaran punca jauh sekali idea, apa guna?

Kadar faedah di Amerika Syarikat naik dengan cepat. Kalau Malaysia ambil tindakan lebih agresif, ringgit berkemungkinan kukuh sedikit tetapi rakyat akan berdepan dengan kadar bayaran hutang yang lebih tinggi. TSMY hendak minta OPR naik berapa peratus?

3) TSMY kata:

Ada rakyat yang lambat bayar hutang atau ikat perut.

Jawapan:

Sememangnya ada rakyat yang sedang susah. Memang ada PKS yang susah. Tetapi lihat usaha yang dibuat dalam Bajet 2022, antaranya seperti disebut di poin (1). Pinjaman tanpa faedah, pinjaman dengan moratorium 6 bulan semua antara usaha dalam Semarak Niaga.

DSIS juga pernah menyeru kepada institusi kewangan untuk tidak ambil tindakan terhadap mana-mana PKS yang gagal bayar balik pinjaman. Malah, Bank Rakyat dan SME Bank antara institusi perbankan yang tidak ambil apa-apa tindakan.

Zaman Tan Sri Muhyiddin seolah-olah tidak ada yang ikat perut? Adakah kita lupa apa yang telah berlaku?

Ramai tidak mampu membeli keperluan asas sehingga rakyat minta bantuan dengan mengangkat bendera putih. Yang itu apa pula komen TSMY?

4) TSMY kata:

Malaysia import sebahagian besar keperluan makanan.

Jawapan:

Dari dulu lagi. Tetapi apa yang TSMY buat semasa jadi PM untuk memperbaiki kedudukan keselamatan makanan?

Bawah DSIS, tindakan berani dengan penghapusan AP, pembekuan eksport ayam ke luar negara, kemudahan pinjaman untuk petani dan pengeluar makanan, subsidi untuk pengusaha ayam dan lain-lain.

Isu keselamatan makanan ini semua kesinambungan dari dasar-dasar semasa zaman Pak Lah dan Dato’ Sri Najib. Dari Dasar ‘Pertanian untuk semua’ ke Dasar Agromakanan negara.

Apa dasar TSMY? Atau legasi beliau?

5) TSMY kata:

Eloklah pilihan raya diadakan supaya Kerajaan baharu dapat dipilih oleh rakyat.

Jawapan:

Habis tu kenapa tuntut jawatan TPM dan Menteri-menteri? Bab mendapat mandat dari pilihanraya ni BN sudah sebut semenjak Februari 2020 lagi. Berbeza dengan TSMY. Jangankan pilihanraya, sidang Parlimen pun dielak melalui darurat. Jadi agak janggal bila tiba-tiba bercakap tentang mandat rakyat. Apapun, bila PRU sampai kita lihat siapa yang sebenarnya gagal.

Natijahnya, dalam hal ekonomi ini, tiada yang sempurna. Masih banyak masalah perlu diatasi. Tapi sekurang-kurangnya batu asas telah diletak dan kemajuan dicapai dari kedudukan bawah semasa TSMY letak jawatan. Dari semua kemajuan itu, kita akan teruskan usaha.

Congratulations to the Pahang state government for taking firm action by cutting down 200 durian trees planted by land trespassers.

Raub Member of Parliament Chow Yu Hui and the land trespassers have no need to shout or scold the enforcement officers.

“It's not the tree’s fault!”

Of course the trees aren’t at fault. The ones at fault are you—for trespassing on government land and doing as you please!

Let’s ask some simple, emotion-free questions:

1. Is that land yours? Yes or no?

2. If not, do you have a rental agreement with the landowner?

3. If you don’t, do you have permission from the landowner to plant durians there?

4. Over the decades, have you ever paid rent to the landowner?

If not, then be a Malaysian who upholds the rule of law.

Every state government and local council should act as firmly as the Pahang state government in dealing with land trespassers. Say whatever you want.

Even if you’ve put up stakes, planted, and lived there for decades or even a hundred years—if it’s not yours, then it’s not yours.

Others who are honest and follow the law buy or rent land, while trespassers use land for free. And when the rightful owner wants their land back, you have the audacity to protest and demand compensation?

Compensation is not what should be given—prison sentences and fines must be imposed!

The Push for Local Government Elections 

Human rights activist Kua Kia Soong has penned a very long opinion piece on the need to reinstate local government elections. (1)

I agree with many of the points he raised. It is all well reasoned. 

There are also a lot of concerns from right wing politicians about whether DAP will implement local government elections or not. 

I dah jelaskan dulu bahawa pihak kerajaan negeri akan hilang terlalu banyak kuasa sekiranya pilihanraya kerajaan tempatan dilaksanakan.  

Tapi takpe, saya boleh bagi beberapa sebab lagi kenapa pilihanraya untuk kerajaan tempatan itu adalah political suicide bagi pilihanraya di kawasan DUN. 

Okay, tidak boleh dinafikan memang ada syarikat yang akan membuat derma politik kepada parti politik untuk tujuan pilihanraya. 

PM Anwar dakwa PN mendapat dana dari sumber syarikat perjudian, tapi saya rasa ada juga pihak ketiga yang pernah mendakwa Anwar sendiri pernah mendapat derma politik dari syarikat perjudian. 

Apa pun kebenarannya, memang ada penderma. Dan antara pihak penderma yang banyak adalah mereka yang terlibat dengan apa-apa bisnes yang memerlukan pengusahaan tanah. 

Contohnya: Projek pembangunan, pengusahaan hutan simpanan (biasanya untuk tanam durian) dan pembalakan. 

Apa yang kita perlu faham ialah bisnes macam ini memerlukan kelulusan pelbagai benda dari pihak berkuasa negeri dan juga pihak berkuasa tempatan (PBT). 

Jadi bagi syarikat ni, mereka akan menderma kepada pihak yang mungkin sekali akan jadi kerajaan. Sebabnya, mereka nak senang dapat kelulusan projek mereka nanti. 

Dulu senang saja derma semua ke BN. Tapi semenjak PH mula menang, maka kebiasaannya syarikat semua akan menderma kepada kedua-dua pihak. Play safe. 

Dah la derma semua dibahagikan diantara PN dan PH di peringkat Negeri dan juga peringkat Parlimen, tapi sekarang ada pula pilihanraya PBT. Perlu ke syarikat bagi derma sekali lagi untuk ahli politik yang bertanding kat peringkat PBT? 

Ha. Nampak tak sekiranya kita ada pilihanraya PBT, derma itu akan dibahagikan sekali lagi.

Dan kamu semua jangan pandai² nak cakap derma ni semua tak diperlukan ya. Kamu ingat bendera dan poster semua tu jatuh free dari langit ke? Duit minyak siapa bayar? Deposit calon? 

Kalau ikut sistem sekarang di mana Ahli Majlis semua dipilih Menteri Besar ataupun Chief Minister, kalau dah derma kat peringkat negeri, boleh la pihak berkuasa negeri kau tim dan mengarah PBT untuk buat apa yang diperlukan.

Dan sekiranya Ahli Majlis nak lawan balik, MB boleh serta-merta pecat Ahli Majlis tu dan lantik seorang lagi Ahli Majlis yang boleh menerima arahan, no questions asked. Senang.

Would you, as an elected politician, want to lose control of this mechanism? 

So, while I won't say the reinstatement of local government elections is impossible, it is highly improbable given that it complicates the relationship between donors and politicians too much. 

What is good for the voter is not always good for the politician. 

Peace.

THE FIGHT AGAINST CORRUPTION

1. The public generally believes that all those who are in a position of power must be corrupt. You can do your best to reject corruption but no one will believe you.

2. Throughout my career I had rejected corruption. I did my best to show that I was not corrupt when I was the Prime Minister.

3. I did not live a lavish life. Yes, I built two houses but they were built with Government loans to which I was entitled and through borrowing from a bank. They were not expensive and I was able to pay the loans with my salary and allowance as Prime Minister. I don’t owe anything to anyone since then.

4. Actually my pay was more than sufficient to support me and my family. It was sufficient because the Government provides me with housing, pay my electricity and water bills, make available to me several motor vehicles, even airplanes for my use.

5. I get paid allowances for moving around the country to do my work or even when taking holidays abroad.

6. The only thing I had to pay for is the food I and my family consumed and my clothing. Even this was not much as I get invited to functions where food was served.

7. I did not ask for scholarships for my children. I could afford to pay for their education. As Prime Minister, I earned more than ten times what I earned as a private medical practitioner.

8. I bought no shares except for 200 British American Tobacco shares which I bought before I became a member of Parliament. The only shares I bought after I joined the Government were those in Permodalan Nasional and other official funds when I launched those funds. But usually not more than 1,000 shares. The return was not big. I did not sell or buy these shares. They remain with the funds and they grow as I did not take dividends. I did not buy shares in the stock market.

9. My children were not allowed to do business with the Government. They were not even allowed to be involved in politics. Certainly not to join UMNO. Most of the business they did when I was Prime Minister were in foreign countries. I did not want to be accused of nepotism.

10. As President of UMNO I was often offered donations for the party. All those donations were given to UMNO. I kept nothing. In fact, I paid for all the campaigning for my own elections. In those days payments for party workers were small and affordable. The normal party allocation for the constituency during elections went to the division and was spent for its management and the conduct of the election. I paid for the cigarettes and nasi lemak occasionally.

11. As Prime Minister I received a lot of gifts. I did not regard them as given to me personally. I regarded them as gifts to the Office of Prime Minister. Accordingly, I registered them as properties of the Government, especially the motor cars. All these gifts are in the Galleria in Langkawi and in my old (Prime Minister’s official) residence in Kuala Lumpur.

12. All these things I did and more to avoid being accused of corruption. But still, I am accused of being corrupt. In fact, many people believe that I have huge amounts of money stashed abroad. No evidence has been revealed that I had this great wealth. But that does not mean that it is not true that I did not have this wealth. It is just that I am said to be clever at hiding my great wealth.

13. This refusal to admit that I am not corrupt affects my efforts to clean up the country of corruption. When I try to campaign against corruption people became cynical. They just cannot believe I am sincere because apparently, I myself am so corrupt.

14. Yet this anti-corruption campaign is very important as I see how corruption is destroying the country. It has come to the stage when Governments can be bought through corruption. And when such a Government is installed, Government funds would be stolen and the country just cannot develop. It will become poorer and poorer and would fail as a nation.

15. The people will suffer as the cost of dealing with the Government would become prohibitive and service would deteriorate. Investments would decline and job creation would not meet the demand of the unemployed workers.

16. So what, some would say. Many countries would be like us.

17. Well, if we are ready and willing to become a failed country it is okay.

18. But we would be looked down upon and would be begging from the rich. We cannot stand tall and be respected.

19. Because of this, I think it is important to elect Governments that are not corrupt.

20. Generally the people do not trust politicians. They believe all of them are corrupt. So, many people have decided not to vote in elections.

21. If people do not vote in elections, the corrupt politicians will win as they would bribe their corrupt supporters to vote for them. Then the Government of Malaysia would continue to be led by corrupt politicians.

22. But I believe most people do not want corruption to cause us to become a failed nation. We want to become a successful nation. For this to happen we have to fight against corruption.

23. How do we fight corruption. We can campaign to instill in the minds of people the rejection of corruption. We can explain the harm that corruption can do to us, to our society, and to our nation. We must make people be aware that corruption is not only about civil servants accepting bribes for the service they are expected to give, but corruption can result in crooks bribing to win elections and form Governments or members of Parliament being bribed to bring down an elected Government and replacing it with corrupt Government.

24. In Malaysia we have reached the stage where crooks can buy members of elected Governments so as to bring down the Government and replace it with corrupt members.

25. By this time the whole population will become corrupt as the corrupt Government will use Government funds to give citizens money to buy support. The cost of doing business would be high, few will invest and businesses will make little profits. With that taxes will not yield enough revenue for the Government. Pay for Government employees, would be reduced. Their purchases would decrease. Retail businesses would suffer, lose profit, pay less tax and Government funds would be unable to sustain the services for the people.

26. The country will become poorer and poorer and will be forced to borrow money or beg for aid. The decline of the country would be continuous and all the people would suffer.

27. Clearly, if we do not want these to happen. If we do not want to become beggars, we must reject and rid our country of corruption.

28. For this we must reject corrupt people from winning elections and forming Governments.

29. We must monitor closely the performance of Governments. There will be false accusation. These will only be accepted if materially proven. It is common for the corrupt to deflect accusations against them by accusing their accusers of being equally corrupt.

30. The struggle against corruption is a holy struggle. In this struggle, we must all be willing to make sacrifices.

Throwing back in 2018....Bermula pada April 2018 saya telah menerima sesalinan memo bertarikh xx April 2017 yg mencadangkan agar gaji saya ditahan (i.e bayar gaji secara harian ikut jumlah kehadiran). Ditukar ke unit yg saya kurang setuju pd awalnya, still ok sbb masih berkaitan bidang tanah. Yang malang, ditukar ke unit baru dan keluar sekali arahan untuk stop gaji. Of course org belakang tabir yg melajukan proses pertukaran itu adalah org yg tersilap letak tarikh & sign memo bertarikh April 2017. Dialah mastermind yg mengadu domba di sana sini menceritakan ttg keburukan2 & suka menambah cerita...hal yg kecil, diperbesar2kan supaya orang yg dia umpat itu nampak super grand buruk. TAK DIBAYAR GAJI TERUS...AND NO REGULAR FACE-TO-FACE COMMUNICATION, ONLY VIA MEMO...AS IF I NEVER EXIST.

Immediate Boss pun masa tu tak pernah ambil peduli lagi ttg kebajikan officer ni. How do i survived without salaries for many months? Never ever ask, 'are you ok?'. Ya lah, takkan la Boss nak turunkan level gred jawatannya by doing humanity spt itu. 

Then I didn't realize depression episode(s) started to sink in. Apa tanda2nya? It is all well-illustrated in the link that I share here. Pls take a serious look at it, because by noticing those symptoms you never know you can prevent it from getting worse. Anda juga mungkin boleh menyelamatkan seseorang drpd terus-menerus dibiarkan dgn situasi kemurungannya. 

Tanda2 itu berulang2 sehinggalah saya akhirnya mula jatuh sakit secara serius mulai Feb/Mac 2019...Saya dimasukkan wad selama 35 hari di PPUM in total (sepatutnya 42 hari, tp Doktor benarkan saya keluar wad for 6 days utk sambut Aidilfitri di Kelantan). Untuk rekod, sepanjang 2019 pun tak dibayar gaji kecuali Mei 2019 saja dibayar itu pun setelah saya ugut, kalau mrk tak takut dgn balasan akhirat...go ahead. Jgn bayar terus jika sanggup tanggung beban dosa spt itu, kita tgk nanti siapa yg akan merangkak di akhirat sana sbb buat zalim tak bayar gaji pekerja.

Menjelang Julai 2018 saya telah luahkan kpd Big Boss pd ketika itu bhw saya sudah tak ada duit lagi utk isi minyak kereta ke tempat kerja. Saya sampai tahap ikat perut semata-mata utk isi minyak kereta ke tempat kerja. The reply that I got was "Kamu tak buat kerja, siapa nak bagi gaji??? You're bullshit (officer najis lembu)". Tp dalam kemarahannya, Big Boss itu ada tanya saya sakitkah? Saya tak berapa ingat apa yg saya jawab...tp rasanya saya jwb saya tak sakit. Cuma saya kata saya mmg dah tak ada duit, mcm mana nk dtg kerja? Takkanlah saya nk buat kerja lain sedangkan tidak ada hitam putih ttg status saya sbg penjawat awam? Finally Big Boss tu kata, "you better change. Improve your attendance. If not you'll be in bigger trouble". For everything bad that happened to me during working my days there, I will not blame that Big Boss. Why? Biarlah saya simpan sendiri sbbnya. Cukuplah Allah Yang Maha Tahu.

Dan kalau saya plan utk buat rondaan ke kawasan Mukim Ampang atau Cheras, saya terus ke sana utk jimatkan minyak kereta. Sbbnya sy sudah tidak dibayar gaji sbb dituduh tak hadir bertugas sedangkan saya bersama2 staff2 saya ada buat tangkapan, sita & rampasan jentera + lori hasil intipan & spot check di lapangan. Siapkan & selesai kertas2 siasatan utk kes2 yg tertunggak sebelumnya hingga dpt jana hasil kutipan kompaun dlm RM66k in a span of 6mths after I took over that unit. Ada jentera curi pasir tanpa permit yg saya & team buat rampasan setelah 2 bulan lebih buat intipan (dlm keadaan saya tidak dibayar gaji), dilepaskan begitu saja tanpa pengetahuan saya oleh immediate Boss sebelum jentera loader sampai utk angkut supaya boleh buka kertas siasatan. Saya betul2 marah dan kecewa, because that incident telah meletakkan saya & team at risk being questioned by SPRM krn kawasan tersebut pernah ada kes SPRM sebelum itu. Dan senang saja immediate Boss ucap "Sorrylah...". Ya, penat & sia2 kerja dgn immediate boss yg kurang spend masa utk teliti kandungan KTN betul2 sblm bagi arahannya. 

Despite that, saya tetap buat kertas siasatan berhubung kes itu utk melindungi diri & team drpd sebarang tuduhan melepaskan jentera yg mencuri pasir atas sangkaan menerima rasuah. Selebihnya saya bertawakal kpd Allah. Sangkaan saya sgt tepat krn selepas itu ada officer SPRM menghubungi saya utk bertanyakan ttg kes tersebut. Alhamdulillah, laporan saya tidak dipersoalkan. Bila kita jujur dgn kerja yg kita buat, kita tidak akan ada rasa bimbang sedikit pun.

Now, kembali kpd cerita tak dibayar gaji. Sementara gaji bulanan tak dibayar berbulan2 lamanya, atas alasan tidak hadir bertugas. Dan paling pelik dlm dunia, sepanjang tempoh itu saya ada submit tuntutan byrn balik bil telefon postpaid (maksimum layak claim RM150/mth), semuanya diluluskan atas pengesahan "pegawai telah menjalankan tugas rasmi" bagi bulan berkenaan. Saya pun tak pasti, sebenarnya manusia jahat itu nak tuduh yg mana satu sbb tindakannya itu jelas & nyata sgt bercanggah. 

Dan lagi satu, sayalah ketua unit yg mengesahkan kehadiran staff2 saya utk claim kerja lebih masa. Setiap bulan. Semuanya diluluskan. Persoalannya, kalau saya betul2 tak hadir bertugas mcm mana saya masih boleh mengesahkan kehadiran staff2 saya? Bukan sekeping dua punch kad yg saya sign setiap bulan. Darablah sendiri jumlah columnya...20plus cards × 26 days x at least for almost 12mths...belum lagi lampiran2 & salinan memo jadual rondaan bulanan & surat2 berkaitan supaya setiap claim kerja lebih masa staff2 saya tidak bermasalah. Saya masih kenal halal & haram punca pendapatan saya untuk tanggung diri sendiri serta mak ayah saya.

Belum lagi saya expose yg saya perasan ada bulan2 tertentu yg punch kad saya dihilangkan semasa pertengahan bulan. Tiba2 ganti letak kad perakam waktu yg baru. Saya mmg perasan ada strategi kotor seperti itu, tp of course pembuktiannya sukar sbb saya tak ada buat salinan punch card sblm ia dihilangkan. And the best part, sayalah yg dituduh menghilangkannya dan diarahkan kembalikan. Emmm agak2lah takkan saya pula nak "mengenakan" diri sendiri dgn melenyapkan bukti kehadiran bertugas? Bodoh jugalah kalau buat begitu pd diri sendiri. Kalau mcm tu, baik resign terus.

SESI TEMURAMAH DYAM TUNKU MAHKOTA JOHOR BERSAMA PENYOKONG BERKENAAN PERLAWANAN ACL, ISU-ISU SEMASA DAN PERANCANGAN JDT

Penyokong: Assalamualaikum Tunku. Terima kasih kerana sudi meluangkan masa bersama patik untuk menjawab beberapa soalan daripada patik. Apa pendapat Tunku mengenai kelab JDT pada musim ini?

DYAM TMJ: Waalaikumsalam. Kami telah turunkan bajet dengan begitu banyak, oleh itu saya tidak meletakkan harapan yang tinggi untuk mencapai sasaran kami. Inisiatif pertama kami pada tahun ini adalah untuk mendapatkan kembali perbelanjaan yang telah dikeluarkan oleh JDT sepanjang tiga tahun ini. Berkenaan dengan falsafah JDT pula, ia telah dimulakan sejak tahun 2014. Walaubagaimanapun, sejak Mario Gomez menjadi Ketua Jurulatih, falsafah tersebut tidak digunakan namun saya berdiam diri dan tidak memberi apa-apa komen kerana beliau berjaya mendapatkan keputusan yang baik. Namun begitu, semua perlu sedar bahawa era moden bola sepak memerlukan kita menuju lebih jauh ke hadapan dan untuk lebih berkesan, lebih banyak perubahan dari segi falsafah dan taktikal perlu dilakukan dan yang paling penting adalah mewujudkan identiti berkaitan cara permainan bola sepak JDT.

Kami kini mempunyai jurulatih baru yang akan menetapkan perkara ini dan juga kehadiran wakil kejurulatihan dari kelab Valencia CF untuk melatih dari peringkat pembangunan belia hingga ke pasukan pertama agar kesemuanya bermain dengan cara permainan yang sama. Jadi sudah tentunya perkara ini akan memakan masa, bukan boleh terus jadi terbaik dalam masa yang singkat. Perkara ini mengambil masa kerana bukan sahaja melibatkan jurulatih tetapi pemain-pemain juga perlu menyesuaikan diri dengan aspek taktikal yang baru.

Memang benar Mario Gomez telah banyak membantu, dan saya mengucapkan terima kasih. Tetapi banyak juga cerita-cerita di balik tabir yang para penyokong tidak tahu. Saya adalah jenis orang yang tidak suka berdiam diri, saya lebih suka bercakap secara telus kerana saya mahu penyokong tahu segala perkembangan kelab, isu-isu kelab dan juga hala tuju kelab. Ini kerana Kelab Bolasepak JDT adalah kelab rakyat Johor dan juga penyokong-penyokong JDT yang kami anggap sebagai Keluarga JDT.

Apabila Mario menandatangani beberapa pemain baru, ada yang sesetengahnya saya tidak berapa setuju. Ini kerana cara permainan yang hendak digunakan oleh Mario untuk pemain tersebut tidak sesuai dengan falsafah yang telah saya tetapkan untuk kelab. Ya, memang keputusannya bagus tetapi apabila saya melihat keseluruhannya dari segi persiapan (sewaktu pra-musim) tidak ada peningkatan jika dibandingkan dengan cara permainan musim lepas. 

Ditambah dengan ketiadaan Jorge Pereyra Diaz dan Martin Lucero yang kita telah jual, saya lihat pemilihan yang telah dilakukan tidak sesuai dengan visi yang telah ditetapkan di JDT. Oleh itu saya telah mengambil keputusan untuk saya dan Mario Gomez membawa haluan masing-masing. Memang tidak boleh dinafikan bahawa beliau cukup bagus, tetapi di JDT tidak ada mana-mana individu yang lebih besar dari kelab. Sekiranya kelab ada falsafah dan polisi itu adalah perkara yang perlu diberikan keutamaan.

Penyokong: Malam ini JDT akan bertemu dengan kelab Thailand untuk aksi pusingan kelayakan ACL kedua bertemu Bangkok United. Ia adalah kali ketiga JDT berada di pusingan kelayakan ini. Apa komen Tunku?

DYAM TMJ: Pada saya, kita semua sedar bahawa cara permainan bola sepak di Thailand adalah lebih maju daripada di Malaysia, dan mereka lebih bagus serta lebih berpengalaman. Falsafah permainan mereka adalah lebih kurang seperti apa yang telah JDT mula laksanakan sejak tahun 2014. Dan satu lagi, JDT adalah satu-satunya kelab yang bermain tiga kali berturut-turut untuk kelayakan ACL, oleh itu saya tahu betapa prestijnya pertandingan ini dan saya amat menghargainya. Saya turut bersyukur kerana belum pernah lagi ada kelab dalam Malaysia yang berada dalam saingan kelayakan ACL sebagaimana JDT laluinya untuk tiga tahun berturut-turut. Ini merupakan satu penghormatan yang tinggi buat kelab JDT. 

Menang atau kalah bukan perkara utama tetapi secara tidak langsung ianya telah meletakkan standard JDT pada satu taraf dan perkara ini harus diteruskan untuk masa-masa yang akan datang. Sekiranya menang Alhamdulillah, tetapi jika tidak sekalipun, sekurang-kurangnya kita tetap berada dalam saingan AFC. Lagi pula, bermain dalam kelayakan ACL ini adalah sesuatu yang sangat berprestij. Namun begitu, saya adalah seorang yang realisitik. Saya sedar JDT belum bersedia untuk bermain di peringkat ACL tetapi kami tetap akan mencuba dan berjuang untuk melihat berapa jauh kami boleh pergi. Itu lebih mustahak daripada tiada sasaran kerana kelab semestinya mempunyai sasaran.

Penyokong: Bagaimana dengan prestasi pemain-pemain baharu tempatan dan luar negara JDT buat masa ini?

DYAM TMJ: Mengenai pemain tempatan, saya sangat berpuas hati kerana saya boleh nampak mereka boleh pergi lebih jauh lagi. Beberapa pemain luar negara kita belum nampak lagi hasilnya tetapi saya rasa saya amat suka dengan prestasi Gonzalo Cabrera. Untuk Brian Ferreira pula saya tahu beliau mempunyai potensi yang tinggi cuma masih baru lagi dan baru berusia 22 tahun, jadi perjalanan beliau masih panjang. Hariss Harun pula akan kembali setelah tamat tempoh pinjaman. Beliau akan kembali pada tahun 2018 kerana Liga Malaysia akan membenarkan 5 kuota pemain luar negara dan beliau akan mengisi kekosongan tersebut. Apa-apa pun saya lihat masih akan ada perubahan dalam bulan Jun kerana pada masa ini saya tidak berapa berpuas hati namun kami perlu bersikap realistik kerana inilah bajet yang ada. Kalau setiap tahun hendak kejarkan piala, setiap tahun hendak menjadi juara, dan setiap tahun hendak berbelanja, satu hari nanti kelab akan lingkup juga dari segi kewangan. Jadi, kita kena gunakan apa yang ada dan Insya-Allah tengoklah nanti bagaimana. 

Buat masa ni saya berpuas hati dengan dedikasi dan komitmen pemain-pemain serta jurulatih yang ada. Saya rasa sangat senang bekerja dengan Benjamin Mora kerana laporan yang terperinci diberikan setiap hari, beliau juga akan menelefon saya dan berbincang dengan saya. Beliau masih muda dan kami berdua ingin mencapai sasaran-sasaran kami. Saya yakin dan tahu beliau memerlukan masa kerana dalam bola sepak sememangnya masa amat diperlukan. Saya yakin beliau adalah jurulatih yang paling sesuai untuk JDT buat masa ini.

Penyokong: JDT sekali lagi bakal mengharungi jadual yang padat pada musim ini. Apakah perancangan Tunku sendiri dan jurulatih mengenai perkara ini?

DYAM TMJ: Bagi pandangan saya, kalau dilihat pada jadual yang padat, kami akan bermain sebanyak 49 perlawanan, lebih daripada mana-mana pasukan dalam negara ini. Tetapi itulah yang membezakan JDT dengan pasukan-pasukan lain. Kami boleh gilirkan pemain kami dengan JDT II, jadi saya rasa musim ini sangat sukar. Seperti yang saya katakan, sasaran kami lebih realistik iaitu berada pada kedudukan empat terbaik dalam liga, suku akhir Piala FA dan suku akhir Piala Malaysia. Itu sahaja, sasaran kami sentiasa sama. Jika kami dapat mencapai lebih daripada itu bermakna kami berjaya mencapai penanda aras kami.

Penyokong: Tunku tadi ada menyebut mengenai akan ada perancangan baru untuk kelab pada bulan Jun ini. Boleh Tunku kongsikan serba sedikit?

DYAM TMJ: Betul. Tetapi saya tidak mahu mengesahkan terlalu banyak sangat kerana saya perlu menjaga moral-moral beberapa orang pemain tetapi apa yang saya boleh katakan adalah pada bulan Jun ini akan ada beberapa perubahan dalam pasukan JDT tetapi apa yang lebih penting adalah perancangan saya untuk Disember. Saya sudah mempunyai perancangan untuk bulan Jun dan bulan Disember nanti.

Penyokong: Akhir sekali berkenaan pencalonan presiden FAM, ada apa-apa Tunku ingin jelaskan? 

DYAM TMJ: Benda ini ringkas, yang pertama saya tidak mahu ada sebarang campur tangan kerajaan oleh kerana saya tidak mahu jadi seperti di Indonesia. Liga mereka diharamkan untuk beberapa tahun oleh FIFA. 

Kedua, saya tidak mahu jawatan tertinggi FAM digunakan semata-mata untuk melonjakkan karier politik seseorang. Dan juga untuk jadi hub kewangan yang akan diagih-agihkan demi agenda politik untuk pilihanraya UMNO yang akan datang, dengan sasaran untuk menjadi naib presiden UMNO. 

Bola sepak ini adalah hak milik rakyat, sesiapa berkhidmat untuk bola sepak adalah untuk melakukan kebaikan demi pasukan kebangsaan, integriti dan kualiti liga tempatan dan melibatkan penyokong-penyokong untuk sama-sama dengan persatuan atau kelab bagi membangunkan bola sepak Malaysia. Jadi, sesiapa sahaja yang menjadi presiden perlu jadi individu yang tiada kaitan dengan politik oleh kerana benda ini akan disalahgunakan, itu sahaja. Jadilah individu yang boleh berkhidmat khas untuk bola sepak. 

Struktur bola sepak FAM yang saya cadangkan sebelum ini adalah FAM tidak lagi akan mengendalikan liga. Syarikat-syarikat yang menaja seperti Astro, Fox Sport atau Telekom yang sepatutnya akan menjalankan liga, bukan FAM. FAM hanya perlu menjaga undang-undang dan tatatertib serta pasukan kebangsaan, itu sahaja. Itu bagi pandangan saya, tapi nanti kita tengoklah. Yang sedihnya Malaysia ini bukan rakyat Malaysia yang mengundi tetapi ahli-ahli gabungan. Inilah kelemahannya. Mungkin sesiapa sahaja yang jadi Presiden FAM, kita patut tukar perlembagaan FAM kepada yang baru, iaitu berikan rakyat kuasa untuk mengundi, rakyat yang buat keputusan siapa yang paling layak menjadi Presiden FAM. Undian dari badan gabungan dan penyokong perlu ada. Tetapi tengoklah nanti. Saya ini orang kecil sahaja di JDT. Saya menjaga kelab kecil, jadi saya akan fokus untuk menjaga kelab kecil saya ini. Saya hanya orang kecil yang tidak sama seperti orang besar yang ada-ada sekarang ini untuk menjadi presiden.

Penyokong: Terima kasih Tunku. 

DYAM TMJ: Sama-sama.

HRH CROWN PRINCE OF JOHOR INTERVIEW SESSION WITH FANS REGARDING ACL MATCH, CURRENT ISSUES AND JDT PLANNING

Fans: Assalamualaikum Tunku. Thank you for spending time with us to answer some questions from us. What are you thoughts Tunku, on JDT this season?

HRH TMJ: Waalaikumsalam. We have reduced our budget by a lot, so I don’t have much expectation to achieve our goals. Our first initiative this year is to recoup the money spent by JDT in the past three years. Regarding the JDT philosophy, it has started since 2014. Having said that, when Mario Gomez became the head coach, the philosophy wasn’t followed but I chose to remain quiet and didn’t comment on it because he succeeded to produced good results. However, everyone needs to realise that the modern football era needs us to go even further and to be more effective, there are many changes required in terms of philosophy and tactics and most importantly is to create an identity associated with JDT’s playing style.

We have a new coach who will put an emphasis on that and we have brought in Valencia CF coaching representatives to train JDT from the youth development level to the first team. With this, everyone will play the same way. This will definitely take time and we won’t become the best in a short period of time. This will take time because it will involve not only the coaches but also the players as they would need to adjust to the new tactical aspects. 

It’s true that Mario Gomez helped a lot and I gratefully say Alhamdulillah. But there are things behind the scenes that fans don’t know. I’m not the kind of person who stays quiet and I prefer to speak frankly because I want the fans to know the club’s latest developments, issues and directions. It is because JDT is the club belonging to all Johoreans and JDT fans whom we consider as the JDT Family.

When Mario signed several new players, there were some that I disagreed with. It was because the playing style that Mario wanted to use for those players did not fit into the philosophy I had set for the club. Yes, the results were good but when I looked at the bigger picture in terms of preparation (during preseason), there were no improvements compared to last season’s style of playing.

On top of the departures of Jorge Pereyra Diaz and Martin Lucero, I felt that the selections made did not fit the vision at JDT. So I decided that it was best forMario Gomez and I to part ways. It cannot be denied that he’s a good coach, but at JDT nobody is bigger than the club. If the club have a philosophy, that should be the priority.

Fans: Tonight JDT will face Thai side Bangkok United in the ACL second qualifying round. It will be JDT’s third time at this stage. What’s Tunku’s comment?

HRH TMJ: For me, we need to realise that the playing style in Thailand is so much more advanced than Malaysia, and they are better and more experienced. Their playing philosophy is more or less similar to what JDT have tried to create since 2014. Adding to this, JDT is the only local club to play in the ACL qualifying phase for three consecutive years, so I know how prestigious the tournament is and I really appreciate it. I’m also grateful that we are there where as no other clubs in Malaysia reaching the ACL qualifying phase three years in a row just like JDT have. It is a huge honour for JDT. 

Win or lose is not the important thing but it has indirectly put JDT’s standard at a level and it needs to be continued with in the future. If we win, Alhamdulillah, but if we don’t, at least we will get to compete in the AFC Cup. Furthermore, playing for the ACL qualifications is very prestigious. However, I’m a realist. I’m aware that JDT is not yet ready to play in the ACL but we will still need try and fight to see how far we can go. It is more important than having no targets because a club must always set targets.

Fans: What about the performances of the new JDT local and foreign players?

HRH TMJ: Regarding the local players, I’m very satisfied because I can see that they can go even further. Some of our foreign players haven’t shown their full potential yet, but I like what I have seen from Gonzalo Cabrera so far. For Brian Ferreira, I know he has a huge potential and having just turned 22 years old, he still has a long football journey. Hariss Harun will return at the end of his loan spell. He will return in 2018 because by then the M-League will allow up to five foreign players per team and he will fill up the spot. Whatever it is, there will be changes in June because at the moment I am not fully satisfied but we need to be realistic because it is based on the budget we have. If every year we want to win trophies, become champions and spend money, one day the club will suffer financially. So, we need to use what we have and Insya-Allah we will see how it goes.

At the moment I’m satisfied with the dedication and commitment shown by the current players and coaches. I feel easy working with Benjamin Mora because of the detailed reports given every day and every day he calls me and gives me full reports and discusses with me. He is still young and both of us want to reach our targets. And I am confident and know that he needs time because in football, time is very important. I’m confident that he is the most suitable coach for JDT at the moment.

Fans: JDT will have a packed schedule this season. What are the plans of Tunku and the coach on this matter?

HRH TMJ: In my opinion, if we look at the schedule, we will play 49 matches, which is a lot more than any other team in this country. But that’s what separates JDT from the rest. We can rotate our players with JDT II, so I feel the season is a tough one. As I said, our targets are realistic: finish top four in the league and reach the quarter-finals of the FA Cup and Malaysia Cup. That’s all, our targets are the same. If we achieve anything more than that, it means we manage to reach our benchmark.

Fans: Tunku earlier said about changes at the club in June. Can Tunku share a little about them?
